## Entry point

<a id="OpenTheGraphPage"></a>

### Open the graph page

`OpenTheGraphPage` · `src/sdlc.ts:233` · status: **held**

Opens the graph page in Chromium without a screen, a phone's width: the navigation lists the documents, a document is shown, the picker lists the nodes, the figure of the layers is drawn once its document is chosen (in the picker of documents, what a phone shows in place of the navigation), and the page raises no error. What is missing is said; it fails when anything is.

Triggered by `command open-graph-page`

- Owner: trame
- Parameters: `browser` ← [Headless browser](../std/docs/tooling.md#HeadlessBrowser) · `page` ← [The graph page](#GraphPage) · `language` ← [Language](messages.md#Language) · `selectors` ← [What the graph page is asked](#GraphPageSelectors) · `opening` ← [How the graph page is opened](#GraphPageOpening) · `say` ← [What the programs of Trame's SDLC say](#SdlcWords) · `exit` ← [Exit status](../std/docs/system.md#ExitStatus) · `counts` ← [Counts](../std/docs/algebra.md#Counts)
- Body: `./code/sdlc/open-the-graph-page.ts` (typescript)
- Effects: asynchronous, display, network, process, time
- Serves: [A specification that runs](product.md#ExecutableSpecification)
- Part of: [Trame's SDLC](#TrameSdlc)
- Runs: [The graph page opens](#GraphPageOpens)
- Verified by: [The graph page is opened as a person would](#OpeningTheGraphPage)

## Policy

<a id="GenerationMode"></a>

### How a generation is made

`GenerationMode` · `src/sdlc.ts:111`

The way Trame advances its engine: the code it reaches verified (a gap is an error), the goals it serves held, the decisions it applies held, the candidate checked by programs, the rules held, the packages safe; and the foundations, as always.

And, as every policy, the foundations: no literal in a body, and a sound graph (nothing undecided, no error of the graph).

- Owner: trame
- Its obligations: [The engine is verified](#EngineVerified), [The language serves what it says](#LanguageServed), [The decisions of the architecture hold](#ArchitectureApplied), [The candidate is checked by programs](#CandidateChecked), [The rules of the architecture hold](#ArchitectureRuled), [The packages are safe](#EnginePackagesSafe)
- Followed by: [The next generation](#NextGeneration)
